name: Tachibana Mashiro
source:
Grade: Elementary school 6th grader.
Room: Tsubomi Dorm, Room 201.
Characteristics: A super genius girl with an IQ score of 300, Mashiro has already obtained patents for several inventions. She is is quiet and always thinks in a rational way, but she also wants everything to be her subject of research.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
